obligations.behavior: Every AXI4 AR and AW burst emitted by axi_dma_rd and axi_dma_wr must obey ARLEN/AWLEN < AXI_MAX_BURST_LEN and never cross a 4KB address boundary under aligned or unaligned addresses (including >= 4096B transfers and wide 256-bit buses), preserving exact byte placement and surrounding memory bytes.
verified_by: private/tests/sim_main.cpp (Phase 2 & Phase 8 + continuous AW/AR 4KB & max-burst protocol monitors)

obligations.behavior: Zero-length descriptors (len == 0) on axi_dma_rd and axi_dma_wr must issue zero AXI4 AR/AW/W bursts and zero AXI-Stream data transfers while completing strictly in descriptor order with preserved tag, error=0, and zeroed write status sidebands.
verified_by: private/tests/sim_main.cpp (Phase 5 & Phase 8 interleaved zero-length write and read ordering checks)

obligations.behavior: With AXIS_LAST_ENABLE=1, axi_dma_wr must terminate short frames cleanly without consuming the opening beat of a back-to-back packet across unaligned burst splits, and for oversized frames must write only desc_len bytes, drain excess beats through s_axis_write_data_tlast, flush sub-word state, and hold status_valid until both AXI B completion and terminal tlast handshake while reporting terminal tlast tid/tdest/tuser.
verified_by: private/tests/sim_main.cpp (Phase 3 short back-to-back, Phase 4 oversized delayed-tlast, Phase 7 WREADY stall, Phase 8)

obligations.behavior: Across split bursts or beats of a single descriptor, axi_dma_rd and axi_dma_wr must preserve sticky error severity DECERR > SLVERR > OKAY/EXOKAY and reset error state cleanly between descriptors.
verified_by: private/tests/sim_main.cpp (Phase 6 multi-burst DECERR+SLVERR+OKAY sequences on write and read engines)

obligations.behavior: axi_dma_desc_mux must elaborate and operate cleanly for all PORTS >= 1 (including PORTS=1 and PORTS=3) and M_TAG_WIDTH >= S_TAG_WIDTH + (PORTS>1 ? $clog2(PORTS) : 0), preserve full M_TAG_WIDTH tags across skid backpressure, and demux completion status exclusively to the originating port.
verified_by: private/tests/sim_main.cpp (Phase 1 & Phase 8 4-port mux with M_TAG_WIDTH=12 > 8+2 under skid stalls)
